title: Return
description: Product return request initiated by a customer. Tracks return reason, status, refund amount, request date, and processing completion date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the return request

order_id.description: Foreign key reference to the original order being returned

reason.description: Reason for the return (e.g., defective item, wrong size, not as described, changed mind)

status.description: Current return status (e.g., requested, approved, in_transit, received, processed, rejected)

refund_amount.description: Amount to be refunded to the customer for this return

requested_date.description: Timestamp when the customer requested the return

processed_date.description: Timestamp when the return was fully processed and refund issued
